# The first perspective save with activate: false is always refused

## Context

The Institution's `FleetPermanenceMatrixRow4NL` saves the live Fleet dock document through the real writer with `perspectiveStore.savePerspective(record, {activate: false, replace: true})` into an empty library. It has been refused since at least engine pin 9 (retained on neomjs/neo-agent-institution#10, 2026-09-14): `["activeLayoutId must name an existing layout when layouts are present"]`. The refusal reproduces on engine `2965d82` and on dev `a50ae57ce8` (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#274).

## The Problem

`savePerspective`'s `activate` option is documented as "Point `activeLayoutId` at the saved record". Into an empty library, `activate: false` leaves `activeLayoutId: null` with one layout present. The whole-candidate validator (`PerspectiveLibrary`'s collection check) refuses exactly that state, so the option can never succeed on the first save. The caller gets `saved: false` and an error that names an invariant it could not have satisfied. Every product caller today activates (the Institution's `CockpitPerspectives` and cockpit controller, the engine's `DockService`), so the defect is latent. `PerspectiveLibrary.spec` only uses `activate: false` after an activating first save.

## The Architectural Reality

`src/dashboard/dock/persistence/PerspectiveLibrary.mjs#savePerspective` already resolves one dangling pointer: a replaced active holder hands its activeness to the replacement, "rather than leaving the pointer dangling (the whole-candidate validator would reject)". An empty library's null pointer is the same case. The saved record is the only layout, so it is the only valid active one.

## The Fix

In `savePerspective`, a candidate whose `activeLayoutId` is still `null` after the save takes the saved record as active, whatever `activate` says; `activate: false` keeps meaning "do not move an existing pointer". Update the option's JSDoc to say so.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `savePerspective(record, {activate: false})` into an empty library saves and makes the record active (a `PerspectiveLibrary.spec` arm, red on dev).
- [ ] AC-2: with an active record present, `activate: false` still leaves the pointer where it was (the existing arms stay green).
- [ ] AC-3 (post-merge): on an Institution engine pin carrying this, `FleetPermanenceMatrixRow4NL` passes. Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#277 (the pin that carries this fix; #274 closes with its PR first).

## Out of Scope

- Relaxing the collection validator: a non-empty library keeps its active record.

## Related

neomjs/neo-agent-institution#274, neomjs/neo-agent-institution#10. The perspective-selection contract is ADR 0029 (`#18606` / `#18618`).
